## 1. Data Processing

```{r}
# Load raw data
df <- read.csv("raw_data.csv")
nrow(df)
```

```{r}
# Variables whose previous-match values we want to retain
prev_vars <- c(
  "minutes_played",
  "total_distance_m"
)

# Add previous-match information
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert match_date to Date
    match_date = as.Date(match_date)
  ) %>%
  
  # Drop rows where the player never actually appeared (0 distance covered), so they aren't treated as a previous match
  filter(total_distance_m > 0) %>%

  # Put each player's appearances in chronological order
  arrange(
    tournament_year,
    player_tournament_id,
    match_date,
    fifa_match_number
  ) %>%

  # Previous matches must be computed separately within each tournament/player
  group_by(tournament_year, player_tournament_id) %>%

  mutate(
    # Match metadata from previous appearance
    prev_match_id = lag(match_id),
    prev_match_date = lag(match_date),

    # Days since previous appearance
    recovery_days = as.integer(match_date - prev_match_date),

    # Previous-match statistics
    across(
      all_of(prev_vars),
      lag,
      .names = "prev_{.col}"
    )
  ) %>%

  ungroup()
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  # Filter out rows where player played less than 10 minutes
  filter(
    !(is.na(minutes_played) | minutes_played < 10)
  ) %>%
  
  # Set reference categories for factor variables
  mutate(
    position = relevel(factor(position), ref = "GK")
  ) %>%
  
  # Normalize statistics by minutes played
  mutate(
    normalized_total_distance_m = total_distance_m / minutes_played,
    normalized_pressing_direct = pressing_direct / minutes_played
  ) %>%
  
  # Add binned minutes_played column
  mutate(
    binned_minutes_played = cut(minutes_played, breaks = c(0, 45, 89, max(minutes_played)), include.lowest = TRUE)
  )

nrow(df)
```

## 3. Modeling

### Running Rate

```{r}
# Ignore rows corresponding to first game at the tournament for a player (missing previous game data)
df_filtered <- df %>% filter(!is.na(recovery_days))
```

```{r}
# normalized_total_distance_m ~ 1 + recovery_days + position
fit1 <- lm(normalized_total_distance_m ~
             recovery_days +
             position,
           weights = minutes_played,
           data = df_filtered)
summary(fit1)
```

```{r}
# Add ns(minutes_played, df=4)
fit2 <- lm(normalized_total_distance_m ~
             recovery_days +
             position +
             ns(minutes_played, df=4),
           weights = minutes_played,
           data = df_filtered)
summary(fit2)
```

```{r}
# Add prev_total_distance_m
fit3 <- lm(normalized_total_distance_m ~
             recovery_days +
             position +
             prev_total_distance_m +
             ns(minutes_played, df=4),
           weights = minutes_played,
           data = df_filtered)
summary(fit3)
```

```{r}
# Add random_effect(team_tournament_id)
fit4 <- lmer(normalized_total_distance_m ~
               recovery_days +
               position +
               prev_total_distance_m +
               ns(minutes_played, df=4) +
               (1 | team_tournament_id),
             weights = minutes_played,
             data = df_filtered)
summary(fit4)
```

```{r}
# Add random_effect(player_tournament_id)
fit5 <- lmer(normalized_total_distance_m ~
               recovery_days +
               position +
               prev_total_distance_m +
               ns(minutes_played, df=4) +
               (1 | team_tournament_id) +
               (1 | player_tournament_id),
             weights = minutes_played,
             data = df_filtered)
summary(fit5)
```

```{r}
final_running_rate_fit = fit5
```

```{r}
# Plot spline curve for minutes_played by fixing recovery days and previous-match distance to median values and random effects set to 0
spline_grid <- expand.grid(
  minutes_played = seq(min(df_filtered$minutes_played), max(df_filtered$minutes_played), by = 1),
  position = sort(unique(df_filtered$position)),
  recovery_days = median(df_filtered$recovery_days),
  prev_total_distance_m = median(df_filtered$prev_total_distance_m)
)
spline_grid$fitted <- predict(final_running_rate_fit, newdata = spline_grid, re.form = NA)

# Overlay fitted curves on the observed data
df_filtered %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = minutes_played,
    y = normalized_total_distance_m,
    color = position
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = spline_grid, aes(y = fitted), linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Fitted Running Rate vs. Minutes Played by Position",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Recovery days = ", spline_grid$recovery_days[1],
      ", Previous-match distance = ", round(spline_grid$prev_total_distance_m[1]), " m"
    ),
    x = "Minutes played",
    y = "Running rate (meters per minute)",
    color = "Position"
  )
```

```{r}
# Extract random intercepts and their conditional standard errors
running_rate_re <- as.data.frame(ranef(final_running_rate_fit, condVar = TRUE)) %>%
  rename(intercept = condval, se = condsd)

# Team random intercepts, with team name and tournament year attached
team_info <- df_filtered %>%
  distinct(team_tournament_id, team, tournament_year)

team_re <- running_rate_re %>%
  filter(grpvar == "team_tournament_id") %>%
  transmute(team_tournament_id = as.character(grp), intercept, se) %>%
  left_join(team_info, by = "team_tournament_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(intercept))

# Player random intercepts, with player name, team, and position attached
player_info <- df_filtered %>%
  distinct(player_tournament_id, player_name, team, tournament_year, position)

player_re <- running_rate_re %>%
  filter(grpvar == "player_tournament_id") %>%
  transmute(player_tournament_id = as.character(grp), intercept, se) %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "player_tournament_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(intercept))
```


```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
# Dot and whisker plot of fixed-effect coefficients (95% intervals)
position_group <- paste0("Position (vs. ", levels(factor(df_filtered$position))[1], ")")
coef_groups <- c("Intercept", position_group, "Recovery days", "Previous-match distance")

coef_df <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(final_running_rate_fit))) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  rename(estimate = Estimate, se = `Std. Error`) %>%
  filter(!grepl("^ns\\(minutes_played", term)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept",
      grepl("^position", term) ~ position_group,
      term == "recovery_days" ~ "Recovery days",
      term == "prev_total_distance_m" ~ "Previous-match distance"
    ),
    units = case_when(
      term == "recovery_days" ~ "meters per minute per day",
      term == "prev_total_distance_m" ~ "meters per minute per meter",
      TRUE ~ "meters per minute"
    ),
    term = sub("^position", "", term)
  )

# One panel per coefficient group, each with its own x-axis title; only the position panel keeps y-axis labels
coef_plots <- lapply(coef_groups, function(g) {
  group_df <- coef_df %>% filter(group == g)
  group_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = estimate,
      y = reorder(term, estimate)
    )) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = estimate - 1.96 * se, xmax = estimate + 1.96 * se), height = 0) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
      title = g,
      x = paste0("Coefficient estimate (", group_df$units[1], ")"),
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 11)) +
    if (g != position_group) theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
})

cowplot::plot_grid(
  cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_label("Fixed-Effect Coefficients for Running Rate", x = 0.01, hjust = 0, size = 14),
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = coef_plots, ncol = 2, align = "hv"),
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.07, 1)
)
```

### Pressing Rate

```{r}
# Ignore rows corresponding to first game at the tournament for a player (missing previous game data)
# Start from df_no_gk since goalkeepers all have 0 presses and drop the unused GK level and set FW as the reference position
df_no_gk_filtered <- df_no_gk %>%
  filter(!is.na(recovery_days)) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(position = relevel(position, ref = "FW"))
```

```{r}
# normalized_pressing_direct ~ 1 + recovery_days + position
pressing_fit1 <- lm(normalized_pressing_direct ~
                      recovery_days +
                      position,
                    weights = minutes_played,
                    data = df_no_gk_filtered)
summary(pressing_fit1)
```

```{r}
# Add ns(minutes_played, df=4)
pressing_fit2 <- lm(normalized_pressing_direct ~
                      recovery_days +
                      position +
                      ns(minutes_played, df=4),
                    weights = minutes_played,
                    data = df_no_gk_filtered)
summary(pressing_fit2)
```

```{r}
# Add prev_total_distance_m
pressing_fit3 <- lm(normalized_pressing_direct ~
                      recovery_days +
                      position +
                      prev_total_distance_m +
                      ns(minutes_played, df=4),
                    weights = minutes_played,
                    data = df_no_gk_filtered)
summary(pressing_fit3)
```

```{r}
# Add random_effect(team_tournament_id)
pressing_fit4 <- lmer(normalized_pressing_direct ~
                        recovery_days +
                        position +
                        prev_total_distance_m +
                        ns(minutes_played, df=4) +
                        (1 | team_tournament_id),
                      weights = minutes_played,
                      data = df_no_gk_filtered)
summary(pressing_fit4)
```

```{r}
# Add random_effect(player_tournament_id)
pressing_fit5 <- lmer(normalized_pressing_direct ~
                        recovery_days +
                        position +
                        prev_total_distance_m +
                        ns(minutes_played, df=4) +
                        (1 | team_tournament_id) +
                        (1 | player_tournament_id),
                      weights = minutes_played,
                      data = df_no_gk_filtered)
summary(pressing_fit5)
```

```{r}
final_pressing_rate_fit = pressing_fit5
```

```{r}
# Plot spline curve for minutes_played by fixing recovery days and previous-match distance to median values and random effects set to 0
pressing_spline_grid <- expand.grid(
  minutes_played = seq(min(df_no_gk_filtered$minutes_played), max(df_no_gk_filtered$minutes_played), by = 1),
  position = sort(unique(df_no_gk_filtered$position)),
  recovery_days = median(df_no_gk_filtered$recovery_days),
  prev_total_distance_m = median(df_no_gk_filtered$prev_total_distance_m)
)
pressing_spline_grid$fitted <- predict(final_pressing_rate_fit, newdata = pressing_spline_grid, re.form = NA)

# Overlay fitted curves on the observed data
df_no_gk_filtered %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = minutes_played,
    y = normalized_pressing_direct,
    color = position
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = pressing_spline_grid, aes(y = fitted), linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Fitted Pressing Rate vs. Minutes Played by Position",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Recovery days = ", pressing_spline_grid$recovery_days[1],
      ", Previous-match distance = ", round(pressing_spline_grid$prev_total_distance_m[1]), " m"
    ),
    x = "Minutes played",
    y = "Pressing rate (presses per minute)",
    color = "Position"
  )
```

```{r}
# Extract random intercepts and their conditional standard errors
pressing_rate_re <- as.data.frame(ranef(final_pressing_rate_fit, condVar = TRUE)) %>%
  rename(intercept = condval, se = condsd)

# Team random intercepts, with team name and tournament year attached
pressing_team_info <- df_no_gk_filtered %>%
  distinct(team_tournament_id, team, tournament_year)

pressing_team_re <- pressing_rate_re %>%
  filter(grpvar == "team_tournament_id") %>%
  transmute(team_tournament_id = as.character(grp), intercept, se) %>%
  left_join(pressing_team_info, by = "team_tournament_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(intercept))

# Player random intercepts, with player name, team, and position attached
pressing_player_info <- df_no_gk_filtered %>%
  distinct(player_tournament_id, player_name, team, tournament_year, position)

pressing_player_re <- pressing_rate_re %>%
  filter(grpvar == "player_tournament_id") %>%
  transmute(player_tournament_id = as.character(grp), intercept, se) %>%
  left_join(pressing_player_info, by = "player_tournament_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(intercept))
```

```{r}
# Reuse famous_players, famous_teams, and n_spread from the running rate section (goalkeepers are not in the pressing model, so they are skipped)
pressing_player_re_subset <- pressing_player_re %>%
  mutate(famous = player_tournament_id %in% famous_players) %>%
  group_by(position) %>%
  arrange(intercept, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  filter(famous | row_number() %in% round(seq(1, n(), length.out = n_spread))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(player_name, " (", team, " ", tournament_year, ")"))

pressing_team_re_subset <- pressing_team_re %>%
  mutate(famous = team %in% famous_teams) %>%
  group_by(tournament_year) %>%
  arrange(intercept, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  filter(famous | row_number() %in% round(seq(1, n(), length.out = n_spread))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
# Dot and whisker plot of fixed-effect coefficients (95% intervals)
pressing_position_group <- paste0("Position (vs. ", levels(df_no_gk_filtered$position)[1], ")")
pressing_coef_groups <- c("Intercept", pressing_position_group, "Recovery days", "Previous-match distance")

pressing_coef_df <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(final_pressing_rate_fit))) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  rename(estimate = Estimate, se = `Std. Error`) %>%
  filter(!grepl("^ns\\(minutes_played", term)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept",
      grepl("^position", term) ~ pressing_position_group,
      term == "recovery_days" ~ "Recovery days",
      term == "prev_total_distance_m" ~ "Previous-match distance"
    ),
    units = case_when(
      term == "recovery_days" ~ "presses per minute per day",
      term == "prev_total_distance_m" ~ "presses per minute per meter",
      TRUE ~ "presses per minute"
    ),
    term = sub("^position", "", term)
  )

# One panel per coefficient group, each with its own x-axis title; only the position panel keeps y-axis labels
pressing_coef_plots <- lapply(pressing_coef_groups, function(g) {
  group_df <- pressing_coef_df %>% filter(group == g)
  group_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = estimate,
      y = reorder(term, estimate)
    )) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = estimate - 1.96 * se, xmax = estimate + 1.96 * se), height = 0) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
      title = g,
      x = paste0("Coefficient estimate (", group_df$units[1], ")"),
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 11)) +
    if (g != pressing_position_group) theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
})

cowplot::plot_grid(
  cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_label("Fixed-Effect Coefficients for Pressing Rate", x = 0.01, hjust = 0, size = 14),
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = pressing_coef_plots, ncol = 2, align = "hv"),
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.07, 1)
)
```
